_what_this_is: the REAL container-disk occupancy of an A3 pod, measured on axpjsvpzfr5rsb at 2026-10-02T06:16Z, moments after stage D failed with `No space left on device` writing the parent replay's shards and before the pod was deleted. It replaces the guessed floor terms in a3_pricing.FLOOR_SUPPLEMENT_GIB, which understated the floor by roughly 35 GB and which the derivation's own docstring already noted had run a pod out of disk TWICE before this third time.

anchor._authority: df on the overlay, which cannot double-count

du_breakdown_gb._caveat: du over an overlay double-counts hardlinked and bind-mounted paths; these terms sum above the df anchor and are recorded for attribution, not as an independent total

workspace_detail_gb._four_wheelhouses: 15.2 GB of wheel archives, a quarter of the disk, needed only while the two venvs are built
workspace_detail_gb._aad_includes: the repository plus whatever the replay had written when it failed, roughly 4 GB of partial shards

derived_floor_gb._how: the df anchor of 58 GB used, minus the ~4 GB of partial replay output included in /workspace/aad at that moment. Everything else -- image, both session venvs, four wheelhouses, the HF teacher cache, the staged assets and the checked-out repository -- is present before A3 writes its first byte of science.
